question: The approach called ‘magnetic confinement of plasma’ is the scientific principle of which technique?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fusion reactor.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• In a **Magnetic Confinement Fusion**, a few hundred cubic meters of **D-T (Deuterium-tritium)** plasma with a density of less than one milligram per cubic meter are confined together by a** magnetic field**.
 
• A successful configuration must meet three criteria:
 
 
• **The plasma **must be in a** time-independent equilibrium **state
 
• The equilibrium must be **macroscopically stable **
 
• The leakage of plasma energy to the bounding wall must **be small.**
 
 
 
• **​Magnetic confinement fusion** is an approach to generate** thermonuclear fusion power** that uses magnetic fields to confine fusion fuel in the form of **plasma.**
